verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question for an observability platform, but the evidence pack never documents a scheduler, cron-style recurring job, or scheduled workflow feature. Synthetic monitoring is described only as simulating user activity and API calls, with no recurrence or schedule mentioned. Alert evaluation and adding the CLI to a CI/CD pipeline are adjacent features or user-side workarounds, not a product-provided recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
